ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a pilgrimage
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: walk a pilgrimage for my god
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: walked a pilgrimage for their god

plain.li: I've vowed it: a pilgrimage on foot to my god's holy place, and an hour's prayer there.
I owe my god a walk, and I mean to pay it.
[spark:loss] I can't stay in this house with all of them looking at me. I'm going to walk, and pray where it's quiet.
[spark:downed] I was nearly gone. Someone kept me here, and I'll walk to thank them.

warm.li: I want to go and say thank you somewhere that matters, on my own two feet.

blunt.li: Vowed a pilgrimage. I'll go when the work lets me.

cheerful.li: A long walk and a god at the end of it. I can't think of a better day.

gloomy.li: Maybe if I walk far enough I'll find out whether anyone is listening.

cold.li: I made a vow. I will keep it.

plain.li: I walked it. My feet ache, and I've never felt so light.
I prayed where my god is closest, and I came home a little different.

warm.li: I said thank you where it could be heard. I think it was.

blunt.li: Went. Prayed. Came back. Vow kept.

cheerful.li: I made it there and back, and the god was in a good mood, I'm sure of it.

gloomy.li: Nobody answered out there either, but the walk did me good.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a temple
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see a temple raised to my god
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw a temple raised to their god

plain.li: I've vowed my god a temple: a room of its own, fine enough that nobody could mistake it.
Our gods live in corners. I've sworn to change that for mine.
[spark:battle] We lived through that. Somebody up there deserves a proper house for it, and I've sworn to see it built.
[lowtech] I've sworn my god a house with a roof and good things on the walls.

warm.li: I want my god to have a room as good as ours. Better, even.

blunt.li: I swore a temple. We're building one.

cheerful.li: A temple! With carvings! I've sworn it, so now we have to.

gloomy.li: If the gods won't come to us in a hovel, maybe they'll come to a temple.

cold.li: A god served in a corner is served badly. I have vowed a temple.

plain.li: The temple stands. I go in every evening just to look at it.
My god has a house now, and I kept my word.

warm.li: It's beautiful in there. Everyone helped, and I'll never forget it.

cheerful.li: Have you seen the temple? Go and see the temple.

cold.li: The temple is finished to the standard I swore.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: meals for a vow
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone who has vowed no meat until a sick friend recovers wants vegetarian meals kept in the stores, so the vow can be kept.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: Keep at least {TARGET} vegetarian meals in storage or in the home area: the vegetarian simple, fine or lavish meal. Set a bill for them at the stove.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has vowed no meat until someone sick is well, and there's nothing in the stores to keep the vow with.

plain.li: I've made a vow: no meat until they're well. Could the kitchen keep a few meals without it?
I swore off meat for a sick friend. I'd rather not starve keeping my word.
[lowtech] I've sworn no flesh until the fever breaks. A pot of something green would help me keep it.

warm.li: It's a small thing to give up for someone I love. I just need something else to eat.

blunt.li: No meat for me till they're better. Need meals without it.

cheerful.li: Vegetables for a while! My god likes a sacrifice, and I like a stew.

gloomy.li: If my vow is all I can do for them, at least let me keep it.

cold.li: I have vowed no meat. Vegetarian meals in the stores would let me keep it without fuss.

plain.li: There's food I can eat now, and a vow I can keep. Thank you.

warm.li: Thank you. Now I can keep my promise without going hungry.

plain.li: I'll keep the vow on bread and water, then.

gloomy.li: Nobody cares whether I keep my word. I'll keep it anyway.

li.label: meals for my vow
li.description: The kitchen has meals I can eat while I keep my vow. Someone took it seriously.
